content.text: Lots of kids Milo's age (5) are still co-sleeping, and it's very fixable. Try the "sleepover" step tonight: do your normal bedtime routine in his own room, stay until he's drowsy, then leave. Tell him up front that you'll peek in soon. Keep the first few nights small and predictable, and a bedtime chart with a sticker for staying in his bed can help a lot at this age.
